There are no network downloads during build time, no use of `eval`, `curl|bash`, or obfuscated code.

The package provides and conflicts with the non-git version, which is standard practice to avoid conflicts. All operations are confined to the build directory and the package directory. No system modifications or suspicious post-install hooks are present. The code aligns with standard AUR packaging practices for Go projects and shows no signs of malicious behavior.
